# McpFn

> Build, secure, test, and evolve Model Context Protocol servers with stable consumer contracts.

## Documentation

- [Authorization](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/authorization.md) — Protect Streamable HTTP, complete client OAuth, and compose hosted authorization.
- [Connect a client](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/client.md) — Production stdio and Streamable HTTP sessions, inventories, calls, and OAuth completion.
- [Deployment](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/deployment.md) — Run McpFn over HTTP on Node or Cloudflare Workers and keep the transport boundary secure.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/getting-started.md) — Install McpFn, declare a validated tool, and run a server.
- [McpFn documentation](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/index.md) — Consumer guide to building, connecting to, securing, and testing MCP servers.
- [Migrate or adopt incrementally](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/migration.md) — Move a custom MCP server to McpFn or test it without changing its runtime.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/reference/architecture.md) — Source-aligned McpFn architecture documentation.
- [Authorization](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/reference/auth.md) — Source-aligned McpFn authorization documentation.
- [CLI](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/reference/cli.md) — Source-aligned McpFn cli documentation.
- [Client](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/reference/client.md) — Source-aligned McpFn client documentation.
- [Core runtime](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/reference/core.md) — Source-aligned McpFn core runtime documentation.
- [DataFn adapter](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/reference/datafn.md) — Source-aligned McpFn datafn adapter documentation.
- [Package reference](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/reference/index.md) — Source-aligned package documentation and implementation architecture.
- [Inspector](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/reference/inspector.md) — Source-aligned McpFn inspector documentation.
- [Testing and CI](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/reference/testing-and-ci.md) — Source-aligned McpFn testing and ci documentation.
- [Testing API](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/reference/testing.md) — Source-aligned McpFn testing api documentation.
- [Build a server](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/server.md) — Registry, context, profiles, resources, prompts, tasks, and transports.
- [Test and evolve a server](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions/blob/dev/mcpfn/docs/content/docs/testing.md) — Manifests, client profiles, semantic scenarios, authentication, and protocol conformance.
